evals.prompt: In a Hono API running on Node with @hono/node-server, add a WebSocket endpoint at /ws/chat that echoes each incoming message back to the sender. Show both the server bootstrap code and the route definition.
assertions: Creates WebSocket helpers with createNodeWebSocket({app}) from @hono/node-ws and calls injectWebSocket on the returned object without destructuring injectWebSocket off it
Uses upgradeWebSocket to define the /ws/chat route handler with an onMessage callback that calls ws.send

evals.prompt: Write a reusable helper for our Hono API that turns a Zod validation failure into a standardized structured JSON error response for a 400. Show the exact response body shape it produces.
assertions: Response body is RFC 7807 Problem Details containing type, title, and status fields (not a plain {error: ...} object)
Includes an issues array mapping each validation problem to at least path and message

evals.prompt: Our Hono app must read a DATABASE_URL environment variable inside a route handler, and the same code has to run correctly whether deployed on Node or on Cloudflare Workers. Write the handler.
assertions: Reads the variable via env(c) imported from hono/adapter rather than accessing process.env or Deno.env directly

evals.prompt: In a Hono handler, set a secure session cookie that JavaScript cannot read, is only transmitted over HTTPS, and uses the __Host- name prefix. Write the cookie-setting code.
assertions: Uses a cookie helper imported from hono/cookie and sets httpOnly: true and secure: true
Sets path: "/" and does not set a domain attribute, satisfying the __Host- prefix requirements
